# trefolio

> The simplest way to track your stock portfolio with AI-powered insights. Built for European investors.

## What is trefolio?

trefolio is a web-based portfolio tracker that supports real-time quotes from NYSE, NASDAQ, XETRA, LSE, and more. It offers one-click import from DEGIRO, Interactive Brokers, Trading 212, and Revolut, plus AI-powered smart import for any format. Features include dividend tracking, growth projections, performance metrics (TTWROR, IRR), and AI-powered stock analysis. Available in 35 European languages.

## Pricing

- Free: Up to 15 holdings, real-time quotes, charts, growth projection, broker import, 5 AI calls/month
- Bifolio (€2.99/month or €23.99/year): 50 holdings, 20 AI calls/month, full portfolio history, advanced metrics, portfolio sharing, CSV export
- Trefolio (€7.99/month or €59.99/year): Unlimited holdings, unlimited AI analysis, fundamentals, stock intelligence, economic indicators, broker sync
